name: Viper-V10
source:
The third Viper has the same structure as the two previous entries: three unrelated stories with little interaction, but many animated sex scenes.

The stories this time are:

1. "Northern Lights" describes a competition between two young apprentices of kendo. The protagonist, a young boy, is challenging the girl Asuka, who claims to be better than him. He needs to practice in order to win, especially because Asuka promised him she will do whatever he wants if he defeats her...

2. "Children's Play" tells the story of a teenage girl named Yuki, who is in love with an older school mate. One morning she goes to school, only to discover that someone has made pictures of her masturbating to the boy's photo...

3. "Rear Under" follows the adventures of a team of three female soldiers who have to infiltrate the base of an evil robot simply known as "Boss". One of them is captured, and the other two have to save her at all costs.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/viper-v-10]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《Viper》系列第三作延续前两作的结构：三个彼此无关、互动内容不多的故事，以及大量带动画的性爱场景。

本次收录的故事如下：

1．《北极光》讲述两名年轻剑道学徒之间的较量。少年主人公向自称比他更强的少女明日香发起挑战。为了获胜，他必须努力练习——尤其是明日香已经答应，只要败给他，就会任凭他做任何事……

2．《儿童游戏》讲述少女优纪的故事。她爱上了一名年长的同学，某天早晨来到学校，却发现有人拍下了她对着那名男生的照片自慰的画面……

3．《后方突入》讲述三名女兵的冒险。她们必须潜入邪恶机器人“首领”的基地，其中一人不幸遭到俘虏，另外两人则必须不惜一切代价救出同伴。
